description: Izdenka wears a full-length dark navy blue textured coat-dress over an opaque cream long shift. The coat has narrow gold-tan geometric woven borders down the front, around the hem and across the sleeve bands. Brown-grey fur trims the collar and wrists. Two small ornamental metal clasps fasten the upper front. A rust, blue and cream patterned woven sash encircles the waist, with tasseled ends hanging down. The cream neckline and lower hem bear blue geometric embroidery. Sleeves cover the wrists and the neckline stays near the collarbones. Dark brown closed shoes remain visible. Cloth appears wool-like and linen-like, but actual fiber cannot be verified from the photograph.
